summary: BlackRock Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting two routine items: an unregistered sale of 183,697.592 Institutional Class shares for ~$4.35 million under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg S, and a regular monthly distribution declaration of $0.1784 per share (Institutional) payable July 29, 2026. No special-situation event (M&A, tender offer, going-private, etc.) is disclosed. The filing fulfills ordinary Form 8-K reporting obligations for fund share issuances and distribution updates, with no strategic or structural change.
